IPMS provides an international building measurement convention. It must be routed only where measurement methodology is relevant and must not silently override Saudi cadastral/title/planning definitions or assignment-specific measurement requirements.

observedFacts.downloadName: International Property Measurement Standards: All Buildings

records.reviewNotes: RICS independently hosts the IPMS All Buildings publication and identifies its publication date. Applicability remains assignment-specific.

ICMS 3 is a global classification/reporting framework for life-cycle cost and carbon. It is not itself a valuation conclusion and must not replace local cost evidence, quantity-surveying judgment or project-specific cost sources.
RICS corroborates the current ICMS 3 publication and its cost/carbon scope.

Appraisal Institute material is a professional reference family, not a Saudi mandatory standard by default. STARTAK must never infer Saudi applicability merely because the reference is authoritative in another professional context.
SVP is retained as a comparative/professional reference only unless assignment-specific authority requires it.

This verifies current individual professional-license prerequisites at source level. It does not establish that any STARTAK user/reviewer holds a valid license and does not itself validate credentials.
Professional qualification requirements changed in 2026. Credential validation must therefore be effective-date aware and must not rely on pre-2026 static assumptions.

The official Taqeem rules library is the authority index for Saudi professional rule extraction. Each relevant rule document still requires rule-level extraction, effective-date review and conformance testing before production activation.

verifiedConclusions: A direct Taqeem-hosted IVS attachment identifies the standards text as effective from 2025-01-31, resolving the earlier canonical production-text identification ambiguity even though the digital-library catalog label remains inconsistent.
IPMS All Buildings is the current international property-measurement standard family identified by IPMSC and corroborated by RICS, with the RICS publication dated 2023-01-12.
ICMS 3 is the current international cost-management standard family for life-cycle cost and carbon reporting, corroborated by both ICMSC and RICS.
Appraisal Institute SVP/SPP is a professional reference family and is not evidence of automatic Saudi applicability.
Taqeem's current professional-license issuance service requires active basic membership, registration in the professional register, required supporting information and payment of the license fee.
Taqeem updated fellowship policy/experience requirements in 2026, requiring credential validation to be version- and effective-date-aware.
